answers.core: playing sounds via script seems like something highly useful and convenient for programmers and other engines offer that functionally by default .
answers.workaround:
for one off sounds you could instance and delete child nodes  for every sound that needs to be played.    and repeating sounds could be child nodes as traditionally expected. 

however a more advanced and complex system will require many many lines of code and extension plugins to be practical which could cause performance issues.     as you either have to automate the instancing and tracking of sound nodes or have alot of them at once to manage for every scenario.

title: Add a method to play a sound file directly in code without instancing an AudioStreamPlayer node
